name: HOODX Boosted ETH
notes: v1.1 = the KupiaSec emergency-rebalance fix (PR #15): emergency slices at most every 2 minutes and only when the pool agrees with the oracle; emergency slippage 1.5% (contract cap 2%). Every other parameter is unchanged from v1.
Reuses the live signal (the fix is vault-only), so there is no new signal and no seed file. The deploy script requires the signal to be fresh: the Boosted ETH keeper pokes it every 2 hours.
Seed: 0.005 ETH from the deployer (the vault's minimum deposit). The treasury then moves its v1 position across: withdraw from v1, deposit into v1.1 (deposits on v1 stay paused).
Set status to APPROVED and reviewedBuild to the commit of the reviewed build only after FOUNDRY_PROFILE=boost forge test passes on it.
